scenarios.name: new feature architecture planning
scenarios.input_task: Design the API boundary and rollout plan for a new audit logging feature before editing code.
scenarios.expected_workflow: Analyze the decision, compare options, choose a route, define fallback and validation, then hand off bounded implementation to coding-core.
scenarios.completion_report: Decision, trade-offs, selected route, fallback, implementation slice, and verification plan.

scenarios.name: bug fix with refactor
scenarios.input_task: Fix this null dereference and do the smallest refactor needed to make the testable path clear.
scenarios.expected_workflow: Analyze symptom, isolate target, patch narrowly, add or update regression test, verify, and report changed files and remaining risk.
scenarios.completion_report: Changed files, behavior fixed, tests/checks run, skipped checks, assumptions, and review points.

scenarios.name: test writing and code review
scenarios.input_task: Review this diff for missing tests and add focused tests for the failure paths you find.
scenarios.expected_workflow: Use review mode first, classify findings by severity, patch bounded tests, run targeted checks, and report review findings plus verification.
scenarios.completion_report: Findings first when review remains relevant, then test changes, checks run, and residual risk.

scenarios.name: latest official source check
scenarios.input_task: Check the latest official Codex Skill documentation and summarize what our descriptions must satisfy.
scenarios.expected_workflow: Define evidence target, retrieve official sources, synthesize with citations, and mark freshness or limitations.
scenarios.completion_report: Source-backed summary, citations, freshness note, and handoff if implementation follows.

scenarios.name: release gate judgment
scenarios.input_task: Decide whether this prompt candidate is release-ready based on the benchmark and regression results.
scenarios.expected_workflow: Define gate contract, inspect executed evidence, compare baseline and candidate, downgrade unsupported claims, and issue pass/fail/hold verdict.
scenarios.completion_report: Verdict, evidence, failures, skipped checks, claim strength, and next required evidence.

scenarios.name: harness artifact creation
scenarios.input_task: Create a claim-strength checklist and validation fixture for this Codex runtime package.
scenarios.expected_workflow: Identify subsystem and owner layer, create the smallest useful artifact, add validation expectations, verify boundary and claim strength.
scenarios.completion_report: Changed artifact, subsystem, owner layer, validation path, claim boundary, and remaining risk.

scenarios.name: multi-agent coordination
scenarios.input_task: Coordinate separate research, implementation, and review agents for a long-running migration.
scenarios.expected_workflow: Check single-agent sufficiency, choose topology, define roles and join contract, track lifecycle, integrate and verify.
scenarios.completion_report: Topology, roles, lifecycle state, join result, unresolved gaps, and validation owner.
